instruction.text: Read the two texts and compare them to answer the questions.

atoms.text:
Amir:
Today was the first snowfall of the year. I wish it were summer again. I like the heat! I want to go cycling and climb trees. In winter, the snow gets inside my clothes, and I am always wet and cold. My mum can go sledging for hours, but I am always more excited to go inside and drink hot chocolate with marshmallows after we are done.

atoms.text:
Amir’s Mum:
The first snow of the season is my favourite time! Growing up near the Sahara desert in Morocco, I never saw snow. Snow here looks so soft and beautiful, like a blanket. Here, I have learnt to enjoy sledging and other winter sports, although I could live without shovelling the driveway. I am lucky to have lived in such different places and experienced both hot deserts and snow.

b: ++Amir’s mum enjoys the first snow, while Amir does not.
Amir’s mum does not enjoy the snow very much, but Amir loves it.
